sentences.text: Cymatosaurus is an extinct genus of sauropterygian, a group of marine reptiles, that is classified either as a pistosauroid or a nothosauriform.
This animal was small to medium-sized for its group, reaching lengths of 1 to 1.2 meters.
The genus was first described by Fritsch in 1894 and belongs to the family Cymatosauridae within the superorder Sauropterygia. Its parent group is Pistosauroidea.

Cymatosaurus lived during the Early Triassic to the Middle Triassic, specifically from the latest Olenekian to the Anisian stages. Fossils have been found in Germany, and the genus likely originated in the Netherlands.
Scientists debate whether Cymatosaurus is a pistosauroid or a nothosauriform.
